items.briefing:
Cybersecurity firm Infoblox is warning that cybercrime is increasingly operating like a business, with criminal groups using professional tools, services, and networks to launch attacks at scale. This "industrialisation" of cybercrime means Australian organisations of all sizes are more likely to be targeted, not just large enterprises. Scam activity in Australia also remains elevated, with Scamwatch continuing to track a high volume of reports from the public.

Review any unexpected emails or messages carefully — industrialised cybercrime often means convincing, polished scams. If something feels off, verify directly with the sender before clicking any links.

featured.title: Infoblox warns cybercrime is becoming industrialised
featured.quote: Industrialised cybercrime with AI tools poses escalating threat to Australian businesses and consumers.
